articles.title: Police arrest two cattle rustlers, recover stolen cow worth N1.7m in Ogun
articles.summary:
Operatives of SWAT, Ogun State Police Command, on Thursday arrested two suspects for theft and recovered a stolen cow valued at N1.7 million. The suspects, Muhammed Monsur and Olaseinde Olatunji, who are part of a four-man gang, allegedly invaded a dairy farm located at Omitoro, via Coker in the Ifo/Ibogun axis of the state at […]
Police arrest two cattle rustlers, recover stolen cow worth N
articles.hausa_translation: Jiya, 'yan sanda na SWAT, Kwamandan 'yan sanda na Ogun State, suka kama mutane biyu da suke rikicin shuni. Suka dawo da shuni da aka saci wanda ke da daraja na Naira miliyon 1.7. Mutanen da aka kama, Muhammed Monsur da Olaseinde Olatunji, waɗanda suke cikin ƙungiyar mutane hudu, suka mamaye gida mai shuni a Omitoro, gefen Coker a gefen Ifo/Ibogun.
critical_questions: Why were only 2 of the 4-man gang arrested - where are the other two suspects and what is the police's plan to apprehend them?
